simpleminer.config.collectStrategy.descr:
Collect strategy.
 INTERCEPT: Intercept all items dropped along the chain as loot.
 PUREAPI:Try to simulate it as much as possible using Minecraft's vanilla API.
 SAMPLE:After collecting sampleCollectSampleCount drops, if it’s determined to be stable, it will directly multiply by the corresponding number of blocks. 
 Everything else is the same as PUREAPI, and with 60,000 blocks, it’s about 30%~50% faster than PUREAPI mode.
simpleminer.config.blockBreakStrategy.de:
Block break strategy.
 VANILLA: Fully uses the original block-breaking logic.
 PUREAPI: Try to use Minecraft's vanilla API to simulate normal breaking behavior, it's more efficient.
simpleminer.config.rightClickHandler.des:
Right click handler.
 VANILLA: Uses the original right-click logic completely. You can even chain place blocks. 
 NOBLOCKITEM: BlockItem interaction is not allowed, everything else is the same as in VANILLA mode, and it also supports one-click crop harvesting.
simpleminer.config.blockFamilies.descrip:
Block families.
 Determine whether a block can chain with other blocks. 
 Format: A, B, C, separate each item with a comma, supports using ! to invert selection, supports using # to select tags.
simpleminer.config.supportCrops.descript:
Right click handler, NOBLOCKITEM.
 Format: Each item is an individual item, not the same as Block families.
